input.command:
cat > $TMPDIR/a.py <<'E'
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
d=pd.read_csv('learning_mindset.csv')
c="C(ethnicity)+C(gender)+C(frst_in_family)+C(school_urbanicity)+success_expect+school_mindset+school_achievement+school_ethnic_minority+school_poverty+school_size"
d['ps']=smf.logit('intervention~'+c,d).fit(disp=0).predict(d)
m1=smf.ols('achievement_score~'+c,d[d.intervention==1]).fit();m0=smf.ols('achievement_score~'+c,d[d.intervention==0]).fit()
t=d.intervention;y=d.achievement_score;p=d.ps
e=(t*(y-m1.predict(d))/p+m1.predict(d)).mean()-((1-t)*(y-m0.predict(d))/(1-p)+m0.predict(d)).mean()
print(e)
E
python $TMPDIR/a.py
